messages:
maya.cs: Notifying thread  we have a partial indexing delay affecting ~38 onboarding tenants after last night's ingest. Preparing customer note and comp guidance. @liam.eng what’s the quick status?

liam.eng: Saw retry storms on indexer-4 causing memory pressure. Restarted processes and paused aggressive retries. Kicking a controlled backfill now; estimate 1.5-3h depending on hot shards. Will update progress here.

devops-bot: Incident INC-2024-5133 created at 2024-12-02T11:04Z. Index backlog ~8.2k docs. Monitoring: https://int-dash/inc-5133

jess-support: Drafting first customer message. Keeping it tight: apology, expected window, how to request manual import, and goodwill offer for trials. Will send to affected list in 20m and capture replies here.

nina-se: Strongly recommend offering a 1-month trial credit plus a 1-hour SE session for midsize customers. For enterprise, offer priority SE + credit evaluation after impact confirmed. Also ask if they see missing search results vs entire ingest gaps.

omar.pm: Agreed. Hold enterprise credit until final scope. Flagged renewal-risk accounts: BrightPath, AtlasOps. Sales/CS to loop if either replies.

liam.eng: Backfill started: 0% -> 46% after 25m. Throttled to avoid further OOMs. No regressions so far. ETA: ~1.5h for most.

maya.cs: Sending customer comms now. Template: short note + office hours link + manual import request form. We will post hourly updates. Jess will track replies.

jess-support: Sent message to affected list. Two early replies: one asks for manual import for demo tomorrow, one requests credit details. I replied that we’ll prioritise and will follow up with specifics. Pasting customers (anonymized): 
- DemoCo: "Please run manual import, demo 09:30 PT"
- HealthKit: "What qualification for credit?"

liam.eng: Progress update: 79% complete (50m). Hot shard sweep ongoing for remaining items.

maya.cs: Action items recap: Eng to post final completion + per-account status (liam.eng). CS to triage requests + coordinate manual imports (jess-support, nina-se). PM to approve trial credit (omar.pm). Post-incident: customer summary + RCA (maya.cs/omar.pm).

liam.eng: Final: backfill complete at 2024-12-02T13:18Z. All affected tenants reconciled. Will attach short RCA and list of impacted accounts for customer notes within 24h.

maya.cs: Thanks everyone. CS will send a final reconciliation notice and offer the agreed credits and SE sessions to impacted accounts. If any flagged renewals escalate, loop exec-sales immediately.
